description: This file defines the SugarTheme class in PHP, providing utility functions for theme management such as loading CSS, JS, images, templates, handling sprites, and theme configuration within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM project. It includes methods for resource caching, theme inheritance, and rendering theme components.

classes.name: SugarTheme
classes.description: A utility class for managing themes in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, providing methods for loading, caching, and rendering theme resources such as CSS, JavaScript, images, templates, sprites, and configuration.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given image extension if supported.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SugarTheme object, loading cache data and applying default properties.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialize vulnerabilities by disallowing unserialization of the object.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Saves cache data to external files and optionally clears caches upon object destruction.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the theme directory name when the object is cast to string.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Generic accessor for theme properties.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a theme property is set.

methods.name: clearJSCache
methods.description: Clears the JavaScript resource cache.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Flags the theme cache to be cleared on destruction.

methods.name: getThemeDefFields
methods.description: Returns the list of theme definition fields.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to the current theme.

methods.name: getImagePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the theme's images directory.

methods.name: getCSSPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the theme's CSS directory.

methods.name: getJSPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the theme's JavaScript directory.

methods.name: getTemplatePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the theme's templates directory.

methods.name: getDefaultFilePath
methods.description: Returns the default theme's file path.

methods.name: getDefaultImagePath
methods.description: Returns the default theme's images directory path.

methods.name: getDefaultCSSPath
methods.description: Returns the default theme's CSS directory path.

methods.name: getDefaultTemplatePath
methods.description: Returns the default theme's templates directory path.

methods.name: getDefaultJSPath
methods.description: Returns the default theme's JavaScript directory path.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Generates HTML link tags including CSS files for the current theme, supporting theme colors, fonts, sprites, and default styles.

methods.name: getJS
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags for including the theme's JavaScript files.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Resolves and returns the path to a template file within the theme or its parent/ default themes.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns an HTML image tag for a specified image in the theme, supporting sprites and caching.

methods.name: getSpriteMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a sprite based on an image filename.

methods.name: getSprite
methods.description: Returns HTML for a sprite span element with appropriate classes and attributes.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor tag with optional embedded image and attributes.

methods.name: getImageURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL for an image resource within the theme.

methods.name: _getImageFileName
methods.description: Finds the actual file path for an image with supported extensions.

methods.name: getCSSURL
methods.description: Resolves the URL for a CSS file in the theme, with support for caching and inheritance.

methods.name: getJSURL
methods.description: Resolves the URL for a JavaScript file in the theme, with caching.

methods.name: getAllImages
methods.description: Returns a list of all image resources available in the theme and its parents.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration values for the theme, including overrides from global config.

methods.name: getSubThemes
methods.description: Returns available sub-themes registered for this theme.

methods.name: getSubThemeDefault
methods.description: Returns the default sub-theme setting.
